Over its first 10 days (2021-06-21 to 2021-06-30), daily post counts were available for seven of those days, with no data returned for 2021-06-25 through 2021-06-27. Activity began at 227,781 posts on day one and rose to a peak of 302,848 posts by 2021-06-30.
key_points: The Twitter collection startDate is 2021-06-21 with a total collection count of 185,873,222 posts.
No daily count data was returned for 2021-06-25, 2021-06-26, and 2021-06-27.
The highest daily count in this initial period was 302,848 on 2021-06-30, and the lowest reported count was 2 on 2021-06-28.
